description: Shims for chronyc, ntpq and timedatectl first on the root PATH stand in for each time service in its real output format. For each of chronyd, ntpd and systemd-timesyncd: a small offset is OK and one over the default 60s threshold alerts with exit 1, ntpd's milliseconds and timesyncd's '1min 3.2s' converted to seconds. A clock reported not synchronised alerts. No readable service is OK when the kernel says synced and alerts when it does not. A threshold of abc or 0 is refused with exit 1. TERM mid-run (chronyc hanging) still prints one fallback result block, within 5 seconds.

steps.label: Shims for chronyc, ntpq and timedatectl in /usr/local/sbin
outputContains: shims installed

steps.label: chronyd, 0.000123s: OK
outputContains: STATUS=OK - clock is 0.000s off NTP time (chronyd), within 60s

steps.label: chronyd, -75.5s: alert
outputContains: STATUS=ALERT - clock is 75.500s off NTP time (chronyd), over the 60s threshold
<-Start Diagnostic->

steps.label: chronyd, -75.5s with usrThreshold 120: OK
outputContains: STATUS=OK - clock is 75.500s off NTP time (chronyd), within 120s

steps.label: chronyd, not synchronised: alert
outputContains: STATUS=ALERT - clock is not synchronised (chronyd): chronyd reports Leap status: Not synchronised

steps.label: ntpd, 12.345 ms: OK, in seconds
outputContains: STATUS=OK - clock is 0.012s off NTP time (ntpd), within 60s

steps.label: ntpd, -90000 ms: alert
outputContains: STATUS=ALERT - clock is 90.000s off NTP time (ntpd), over the 60s threshold

steps.label: systemd-timesyncd, -49.131ms: OK
outputContains: STATUS=OK - clock is 0.049s off NTP time (systemd-timesyncd), within 60s

steps.label: systemd-timesyncd, +1min 3.2s: alert
outputContains: STATUS=ALERT - clock is 63.200s off NTP time (systemd-timesyncd), over the 60s threshold

steps.label: systemd-timesyncd, NTPSynchronized=no: alert
outputContains: STATUS=ALERT - clock is not synchronised (systemd-timesyncd): timedatectl reports NTPSynchronized=no

steps.label: No readable service, kernel says synced (old systemd, openntpd): OK
outputContains: STATUS=OK - clock synchronised (timedatectl NTPSynchronized=yes)

steps.label: No time service running, kernel says not synced: alert
outputContains: STATUS=ALERT - no running time sync service found

steps.label: Threshold abc is refused
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: usrThreshold must be whole seconds 1-86400 (given: 'abc')

steps.label: Threshold 0 is refused
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: usrThreshold must be between 1 and 86400 seconds (given: 0)

steps.label: TERM mid-run (chronyc hanging): one fallback result block at once, saying it was stopped by a signal; the job ends 143
outputContains: exit status: 143.
result within 5 seconds of TERM
STATUS=Check failed before it could decide (stopped by a signal)
start markers: 1, end markers: 1, STATUS lines: 1

steps.label: Clean up: shims removed
outputContains: shims left: 0
